info.title: API.SH: Google Maps
info.description: The Google Maps API from API.SH: public Google Maps data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Google Maps search suggestions for what a user has typed: places (name, address, coordinates, place_id, feature_id, cid, kgmid) and query suggestions, in the order the search box shows them. `lat`/`lng` (or `location=lat,lng`) and `zoom` bias the suggestions to an area like the map viewport.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-autocomplete

parameters.description: What the user typed.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude to bias around.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude to bias around.

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Map zoom 3-21 (default 14).

parameters.name: hl
parameters.description: Language, e.g. en.

parameters.name: gl
parameters.description: Country, e.g. us.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Same as `q`.

parameters.name: coordinates
parameters.description: `lat,lng` to bias the suggestions, same as `location`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language (same as `hl`, default en).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Country (same as `gl`, default us).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-bulk-search

get.description:
Emails, phone numbers and social profiles (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok, GitHub, Yelp, Pinterest, Snapchat, Threads, WhatsApp) found on a business website: its home page and the contact or about page it links to. Pass up to 20 `business_id` values (the website listed on Google is read) or a `website` URL. `pages_checked` lists the pages read; an empty list means the website did not answer. Billed per business.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-contacts

parameters.name: business_id
parameters.description: The business: its `business_id` (`0x…:0x…`), `place_id` (`ChI…`) or `cid`, up to 20, comma-separated.

parameters.name: website
parameters.description: A website URL to read instead of a business.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language (default en).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Country the website is read from (default us).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Everything the place panel shows, for up to 20 businesses per call (`business_id`, comma-separated: business ids, place ids or CIDs): contact details, address parts, plus code, opening hours and open status, descriptions, rating with its 1-5 star histogram (`reviews_per_rating`), review topics, the About tab (accessibility, amenities, payments, parking…), popular times when Google has them, owner, verified status, business status, links (menu, order, reservations, booking), departments, labels, a photo sample and the first reviews. `extract_share_link=true` adds the short maps.app.goo.gl link; `extract_emails_and_contacts=true` adds the emails and social profiles found on the business website. Results are in `businesses` (and the first in `place`); ids that were not found are listed in `errors`. The older single-place ids (`feature_id`, `cid`, a Maps `url`, `place_id` with `q`) still work.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-details

get.description:
Routes between two points for a travel mode: distance, duration (typical and in current traffic), warnings (tolls, ferries) and turn-by-turn steps. Points are `lat,lng` or a place name (resolved with a Maps search). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-directions

parameters.name: gl

get.description:
Travel distance and time between every origin and every destination (up to 10 pairs), from Google Maps directions: for each pair the fastest route's distance, duration, typical duration and route summary, with a status (ok, no_route, not_found). Also returns each origin and destination as Google resolved it (name, address, coordinates, ids).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-distance-matrix

parameters.name: destinations

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Travel mode: driving (default), walking, cycling or transit.

parameters.name: hl
parameters.description: Language of the answer (default en).

parameters.name: gl
parameters.description: Country code for the region (default us).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A public saved list on Google Maps: title, description, owner, number of places, created and updated time, and each place with its name, the owner's note, coordinates, feature id and cid, when it was added, and a Google Maps link. Up to 500 places per call. Returns 404 for a list that does not exist or is not public.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-list

parameters.name: hl

get.summary: Google Maps places near a point
get.description:
Places around `lat`,`lng` (or `location=lat,lng`), optionally of a kind (`q`, e.g. restaurants, pharmacies). `zoom` sets the area (15 by default: a neighbourhood; 13 a city district; 17 a few blocks); `radius` (metres) keeps only places within that distance, nearest first. Each place carries `distance_m` from the point and the full business record. Each business carries `business_id` (= `google_id`, the `0x…:0x…` feature id), `place_id`, `google_mid`, `cid`, `name`, `phone_number` (E.164), `full_address` with `street_address`, `district`, `city`, `zipcode`, `state`, `country`, `latitude`/`longitude`, `timezone`, `rating`, `review_count`, `opening_status`, `working_hours`, `website`, `verified` (claimed by its owner), `owner_id`/`owner_name`/`owner_link`, `business_status` (OPEN, CLOSED_TEMPORARILY, CLOSED), `type` and `subtypes` (categories), `place_link`, `reviews_link`, `booking_link`, `reservations_link`, `order_link`, `menu_link`, `action_links`, `photos_sample`, `photo_count`, `summary`, `about_details`, `price_level`, `departments`, next to the original fields. Filter by min_rating (places rated at least this) and open_now (places open at the time of the call); like the other filters, they apply to the places fetched for limit.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-nearby

parameters.description: Latitude of the point.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the point.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What to look for (default: any place).

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Map zoom 3-21 (default 15); lower is a wider area.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (20 places per page).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Places to return (default 20, max 200; each 20 is one more page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-photo

get.description:
The place's whole photo and video gallery, paged like the Maps gallery: each item has `photo_id`, `photo_url`, `photo_url_large` (`=s0`), size, location, date (`photo_datetime_utc`), `type` (photo or video), `video_urls` for videos and whether the owner uploaded it. Up to 200 per call (`limit`); pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` (null on the last page). `is_video=true` keeps only videos. The first page also keeps the older `photos` list (cover photos and review photos). Identify the place by `business_id` or as for details.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-photos

get.description:
All of a place's Google reviews, paginated: rating, text, date, author profile, photos, the owner's reply and the guided answers (parking, seating, vegetarian options…), in Google's four sort orders. Each review also carries the other API's names (`review_id`, `review_text`, `review_rating`, `review_datetime_utc`, `author_id`, `author_name`, `author_link`, `author_photo_url`, `owner_response_text`…). Up to 100 reviews per call (`limit`); pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page (`next_cursor` is null on the last page). `query` keeps the reviews that mention every word (a few hundred reviews are searched per call; pass `next_cursor` to search further). The first page also carries the 1-5 star histogram and the review topics with mention counts. Filter by star rating with rating (e.g. 1,2 for the negative reviews); rating and query scan up to several pages of reviews to fill limit.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-reviews

get.description:
Google Maps business search, as the Maps list shows it, with every field of the place card. Each page is the next 20 results; `limit` up to 200 loads several pages in one call (billed per 20). Centre the search with lat/lng and zoom, or search an area: a bounding box (`bbox` or `ne`+`sw`) or a circle (`radius` with lat/lng). Filters: `subtypes`, `verified`, `business_status`. Each business carries `business_id` (= `google_id`, the `0x…:0x…` feature id), `place_id`, `google_mid`, `cid`, `name`, `phone_number` (E.164), `full_address` with `street_address`, `district`, `city`, `zipcode`, `state`, `country`, `latitude`/`longitude`, `timezone`, `rating`, `review_count`, `opening_status`, `working_hours`, `website`, `verified` (claimed by its owner), `owner_id`/`owner_name`/`owner_link`, `business_status` (OPEN, CLOSED_TEMPORARILY, CLOSED), `type` and `subtypes` (categories), `place_link`, `reviews_link`, `booking_link`, `reservations_link`, `order_link`, `menu_link`, `action_links`, `photos_sample`, `photo_count`, `summary`, `about_details`, `price_level`, `departments`, next to the original fields. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page (Maps lists end after about 10 pages). Filter by min_rating (places rated at least this) and open_now (places open at the time of the call); like the other filters, they apply to the places fetched for limit.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-search

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Centre the search on this point (with lng), like the map viewport.

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the centre point.

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: With lat/lng, the map zoom 3-21 (default 14); lower is a wider area.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Places to return (default 20, max 200; each 20 is one more page).

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Search inside a bounding box: `south,west,north,east` (degrees). Results outside the box are dropped.

parameters.name: ne
parameters.description: With `sw`, the box's north-east corner `lat,lng` (instead of bbox).

parameters.name: sw
parameters.description: With `ne`, the box's south-west corner `lat,lng`.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: With lat/lng: only places within this many metres (10-100000); sets the zoom to fit.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Same as `q`.

parameters.name: subtypes
parameters.description: Keep only businesses with one of these categories (comma-separated, as in `subtypes`), e.g. `Plumber,Drainage service`.

parameters.name: verified
parameters.description: true: only businesses claimed by their owner; false: only unclaimed ones.

parameters.name: business_status
parameters.description: Keep only these statuses (comma-separated): OPEN, CLOSED_TEMPORARILY, CLOSED.

parameters.name: extract_emails_and_contacts
parameters.description: true: also read the business website (home page and its contact page) for `emails_and_contacts`: emails, phone numbers and Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, TikTok, GitHub, Yelp, Pinterest, Snapchat, Threads and WhatsApp links. Costs extra credits per business.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Keep only these fields of each business, review or photo (comma-separated), e.g. `name,phone_number,rating`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language (same as `hl`, default en).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Country (same as `gl`, default us).

parameters.name: min_rating
parameters.description: Only places rated at least this (1-5, e.g. 4.5).

parameters.name: open_now
parameters.description: true: only places open now.

get.description:
The Street View panorama nearest a point: panorama id, its exact position, camera heading, pitch and roll, capture month, street address, full image size, copyright or uploader, the neighbouring panoramas you can move to (with headings), older captures of the same spot (time travel), a thumbnail image link and a Google Maps link that opens it. Returns 404 when there is no imagery within the radius.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-maps-street-view

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude of the point (or use location).

parameters.name: lng
parameters.description: Longitude of the point.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: The point as lat,lng, instead of lat and lng.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres (default 50, up to 10000).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: google (default) for Google's own imagery, any to also include photo spheres people uploaded.

parameters.name: hl
parameters.description: Language of street names (default en).

output.name: output

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
